name: EXM_SPEND_AUTHORIZATIONS
description: This table contains the general information for spend authorizations, such as the authorization number, purpose of the authorization, and the person associated with the authorization.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTHORIZATION_ID
columns.description: Spend authorization identifier.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SUBMITTER_ID
columns.description: Person who submitted spend authorization.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person who submitted spend authorization.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment identifier of person requesting spend authorization.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_REQUESTED_DATE
columns.description: Month, day, and year in which authorization is saved or submitted.

columns.name: AUTHORIZED_TOTAL
columns.description: Total amount of spend authorization in functional currency.

columns.name: BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Spend authorization balance amount in ledger currency.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTHORIZATION_NUM
columns.description: Number identifier of spend authorization.

columns.name: PURPOSE
columns.description: Business activities that justify spend authorization.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Functional currency code of spend authorization.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_APPROVER_ID
columns.description: Person chosen as initial approver.

columns.name: CURRENT_APPROVER_ID
columns.description: Current approver of spend authorization.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_SUBMIT_DATE
columns.description: Month, day, and year in which authorization is submitted.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Spend authorization approval status. Possible values are APPROVED, PENDING MANAGER APPROVAL, and REJECTED.

columns.name: AUTHORIZATION_PROCESSING_ID
columns.description: Details identifier of spend authorization.

columns.name: FINAL_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.description: Date when final approval of spend authorization is obtained.

columns.name: WORKFLOW_CORRELATION_ID
columns.description: Human workflow composite identifier of approval notification.

columns.name: CREATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Code for spend authorization creation by devices, sunch as mobile iOS device or mobile Android device.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Geographical location address identifier where user employs spend authorization.

columns.name: LOCATION_ADDRESS
columns.description: Geographical location address where user employs spend authorization.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: First day of spend authorization expenses that spans multiple days.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Last day of spend authorization expenses that spans multiple days.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: XCC_DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Data identifier assigned by Oracle Budgetary Control.

columns.name: FUNDS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds returned by Oracle Budgetary Control API for authorization request. Possible values are from XCC_BC_FUNDS_STATUSES lookup. Example of values are IN_PROCESS, NOT_ATTEMPTED and RESERVED_PASSED.

columns.name: EXM_FUNDS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of funds relative to authorization request. Possible values are from ORA_EXM_FUNDS_STATUSES lookup.  Example of values are ORA_FAILED, ORA_PASSED and ORA_WARNING.
